title: 1992 AHSME Problem 7
statement: The ratio of \(w\) to \(x\) is \(4:3,\) of \(y\) to \(z\) is \(3:2,\) and of \(z\) to \(x\) is \(1:6.\) What is the ratio of \(w\) to \(y?\)

solutions.text:
Multiplying the given ratios, \[ \begin{aligned} \frac wy &=\frac wx\cdot\frac xz\cdot\frac zy\\ &=\frac43\cdot6\cdot\frac23=\frac{16}{3}. \end{aligned} \] Thus \(w:y=16:3.\)

Thus the correct answer is B.
hints: Express both \(w\) and \(y\) as multiples of \(x\)
